text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: 3 nodes in inferpool-west2 reported NotReady within 30s window (kubelet restarts). Severity: high. Affected: inference-serving pods evicted and restarted -> elevated 95th latency for hosted API. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kubelet-flap

morgan: seeing 502 spikes in prod-metrics, spike started ~00:01 UTC. Affected model routes: text-gen-large and embeddings.

liam: checking node events, kubelet OOM messages followed by systemd restart. snippet from journalctl:
```
kubelet[1234]: runtime: out of memory: killed process 9876 (redwood-runtime)
systemd[1]: kubelet.service: main process exited, code=killed, status=9/KILL
systemd[1]: Stopped kubelet.service.
systemd[1]: Started kubelet.service.
```

sofia: hmm saw CUDA driver errors on one node earlier: `GPU0: Xid 79` in dmesg. Could be driver watchdog + memory pressure.

oncall-pager: customer-impact note: ~6% of requests hitting higher-tail errors, ~12% increased p99 latency for embeddings. Ticket #INC-2026 created.

morgan: cordon + drain plan? I can cordon nodes that are flapping to stop scheduling new pods. Will scale up a small extra pool on spare capacity (dedicated-burst) to absorb traffic.

liam: doing `kubectl cordon nodex-34 && kubectl drain nodex-34 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --force` now. Also bumping infer-deployment replicas by 2 in west2 cluster.

sofia: adding fallback routing: update traffic-policy -> route 20% to cold-replicas in other region (us-east). I pushed the change, watch console.

morgan: logs from restarted pod show runtime crash with CUDA OOM and stack:
```
RedwoodRuntimeError: CUDA out of memory when allocating 4.00 GiB (GPU 0)
  at serve_loop (/app/runtime/serve.py:412)
  -- triggered by batch allocation size 256
```
Reducing max batch size for boat-anchor model to 128 as temp mitigation.

liam: kubelet logs also show cgroup pressure 'memory' and 'kernel' complaining. Suspect kernel oom_killer targeting runtime. I've opened an image-ops ticket to check container memory limits + kernel upgrade.

sofia: notifying support for customer comms. Jenna from success looped in. We should estimate ETA to stable: 30-45m if nodes remain cordoned and new pods warm up.

oncall-pager: morgan -> please handoff to next on-call in 20m. if nodes still flapping escalate to infra lead.

morgan: on it. snapshotting current mitigation: 1) cordoned 3 nodes, 2) scaled infer-deploy +2, 3) routed 20% to us-east cold pool, 4) reduced batch size to 128 for high-memory models, 5) filed infra ticket for kernel/driver analysis.

sofia: I'll take over if it persists. good notes. :thumbsup:

sre-tools-bot: action-summary logged to incident channel and appended to INC-2026. Metrics captured: api-95th-latency, pod-restarts, node-notready-count.

morgan: handoff -> sofia in 15m. if any new node enters NotReady, we restart kubelet via `systemctl restart kubelet` after confirming driver state and then isolate node.

sofia: acknowledged. I'll follow up with post-incident writeup once stable.

liam: leaving a small snippet to correlate with kernel Xid errors: `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=memory.free,memory.used --format=csv` run on flapping nodes when possible.

incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated -> degraded. Active mitigations in place. Next update in 10m or on escalation.
